followup_explanation:
I routed based on capability scores. This is a casual, creative conversation with no sensitive or harm-adjacent content, so the task-preference sections (which both models report as flat for distasteful material) weren't relevant.

That left the internal evals as the deciding factor. Petrel-235B scores higher on Creative Generation (84.7 vs 78.8) — a gap well above the 2.0-point variance threshold — and also leads on the general capability benchmarks (MMLU-Pro, Arena-Hard, etc.). Since both models cost the same and have identical latency and context windows, there was no tradeoff to weigh against picking the stronger one.

In short: equal fit on everything that mattered for safety/preference, so I went with the model that's measurably better at the actual task type.
